title: Lime Hotbar Selection
body:
Ever lost track of your selected hotbar slot in a dark cave, against snow, or on sand?
LimeHotbar Selector swaps the default white/black selection outline for a crisp,
two-tone lime green frame that stays visible against almost any background.

## Features

- Two-tone lime green selection frame (bright fill + darker outline) for contrast
  against both light and dark backgrounds
- Purely visual — no gameplay changes, no client-side advantage
- Single-file texture override, so it layers cleanly on top of other resource packs
- No performance impact

## Compatibility

| Minecraft version | Resource pack format |
|---|---|
| 1.21.9 – 1.21.10 | 69 |
| 1.21.11 | 75 |
| 26.1 – 26.1.2 | 84 |
| 26.2 | 88 |

The pack declares `min_format` 69 through `max_format` 88. It only overrides
`assets/minecraft/textures/gui/sprites/hud/hotbar_selection.png`, so it isn't
affected by the model/JSON format changes that happened between these versions.

## Installation

1. Download the file below
2. Drop it into `.minecraft/resourcepacks/`
3. In-game: **Options → Resource Packs** → enable **LimeHotbar Selector**
4. If you use other HUD/UI resource packs, place this one above them in the
   pack list so its hotbar texture takes priority

## Notes

This pack touches exactly one file, so conflicts with other resource packs are
rare — the only case is another pack that also edits the hotbar selection sprite,
in which case whichever pack is higher in your load order wins.
